note.description: note: the new note (an empty string clears it); import: the note of the new snapshot

secret_file.description: export: path of a file (mode 600) holding the obfuscation key

secret_env.description: export: name of an environment variable holding the obfuscation key (instead of secret_file)

confirm.description: favorite and delete: the exact snapshot_id; retention_policy: the exact network_id

definition.description: retention_policy: {enabled, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastQuarter, lastYear, older}; export: {path, only_config, include_devices, exclude_devices, obfuscate_names}; import: {files, exclude_failed_devices, skip_processing}
